mapper.select: select uvas.id, uvas.name, uvas.status, uvas.description, uvaso.id as oid, uvaso.situation_id, uvaso.name as option_name, uvaso.description as option_description from user_voc_ai_situation uvas inner join user_voc_ai_situation_option uvaso on uvas.id=uvaso.situation_id where uvas.status = 1 and uvaso.is_deleted=0

select uvas.id, uvas.name, uvas.status, uvas.description, uvaso.id as oid, uvaso.situation_id, uvaso.name as option_name, uvaso.description as option_description from ( select id, name, status, description, is_deleted from user_voc_ai_situation where is_deleted=0 limit #{offset}, #{limit}) as uvas left join user_voc_ai_situation_option uvaso on uvas.id=uvaso.situation_id and uvaso.is_deleted=0 where uvas.is_deleted=0
